title: LiMA: Bridging Long-term Imagination to Real-time Dexterous Manipulation via Asynchronous Diffusion
authors: Ning Chen, Yankai Fu, Junkai Zhao, Qianpu Sun, Guocai Yao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Shanghang Zhang

tldr.zh: LiMA 用慢速世界动作模型预测未来视觉与粗动作，再以其潜变量作为快速扩散模型的起点，结合最新观测细化双臂双手动作，并通过不同刷新频率减少长程预测对执行的等待。
tldr.en: LiMA uses a slow world-action model to predict future visuals and coarse actions, initializes fast diffusion refinement from these latents, and incorporates fresh observations to generate arm–hand actions while refreshing long-horizon foresight less frequently.

evaluation_scope.zh: 慢层 Future Dreamer 由 Cosmos-Predict2-2B 微调，输入三视角图像和指令，输出未来多视角视觉潜变量及粗动作先验；快层 Motion Refiner 是从头训练的 1B Transformer，读取先验、最新视觉和关节状态，输出近期动作块与主视角未来潜变量。I2SB 以慢层先验和示范执行潜变量为桥两端，训练快层恢复干净执行潜变量；未来视觉还通过仿射调制作用于实时视觉。两层联合监督训练，加边界噪声增强，无 RL；细化发生在生成潜空间，非独立失败检测或直接叠加关节残差。每四次快层更新刷新一次慢层，其间复用缓存并更新观测；不能把频率解耦等同于已实现多 GPU 并行。双 UR5＋双 22 自由度 SharpaWave、三台 D435；六项任务各 100 条遥操作示范、20 次主评测，平均任务成功率 70.8%。H100 上 325 ms 是生成 32 步动作块的摊销延迟，含慢层开销，较 Cosmos-Policy 的 600 ms 降低 45.8%，不是单步控制延迟。未验证跨手迁移或触觉闭环；代码、数据及预训练权重开放状态未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: Cosmos-Predict2-2B initializes the slow Dreamer: three camera views/instructions yield future visual latents and coarse actions. A scratch-trained 1B Refiner consumes these priors plus fresh vision/joint state to generate near-term action chunks and future ego-view latents. I2SB bridges intent and demonstrated execution latents; imagined visuals also modulate live features. Joint supervised training uses boundary-noise injection, without RL. Refinement is generative, not separate failure detection or additive joint residuals. The Dreamer refreshes every four Refiner updates; cached priors do not establish multi-GPU parallelism. Dual UR5s, two 22-DoF SharpaWave hands and three D435s support six tasks, each with 100 teleoperation demonstrations and 20 main evaluation trials; average success is 70.8%. H100 latency of 325 ms amortizes Dreamer overhead per 32-action chunk, 45.8% below Cosmos-Policy's 600 ms, not per-action latency. Cross-hand transfer, tactile feedback and code/data/pretrained releases are unverified.
